records.device_name: Vivid E80, Vivid E90, Vivid E95

ai_features.name: Automatic View Recognition
ai_features.function: Deep-neural-network classification of echocardiographic views to automatically select the apical images fed into AFI 2.0 (LV longitudinal strain) and Auto EF 2.0 (LV ejection fraction), replacing manual image selection.
ai_features.quote: "Automatic View Recognition" is new functionality based on deep neural network embedded into the software of Vivid E95 / Vivid E90. Automatic View Recognition is a tool for workflow improvement to AFI 2.0 and Auto EF 2.0 and provides an automated alternative to manual image selection already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

ai_features.name: AutoEF 2.0
ai_features.function: Automated left-ventricular ejection fraction from 2D apical views; described only as a workflow improvement of existing predicate functionality (no AI/ML method stated).
ai_features.quote: "AutoEF 2.0" is a workflow improvement of functionality already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

ai_features.name: AFI 2.0 (Automated Function Imaging)
ai_features.function: Automated LV longitudinal strain (speckle-tracking) tool; workflow improvement of predicate functionality, expanded to pediatric use (no AI/ML method stated).
ai_features.quote: "AFI 2.0" is a workflow improvement of functionality already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341). In addition to the changes to the tool, we have now expanded if for pediatric use.

ai_features.name: 4D Auto LAQ
ai_features.function: Automated quantification of left-atrial volumes, emptying fraction and strain from live 3D (4D) echo; claimed equivalent to 4D Auto RVQ (no AI/ML method stated).
ai_features.quote: The new features "4D Auto LAQ" is a new feature for quantification of Left Atrium volumes, emptying fraction and strain in live 3D (4D). The feature is substantially equivalent to the 4D Auto RVQ already present on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

records.performance_summary: No performance data reported. records.device_name: Vivid E80/ Vivid E90/ Vivid E95

ai_features.name: AI Auto Measure - 2D
ai_features.function: Artificial-intelligence-based Cardiac Auto 2D feature enabling automated linear measurements on PLAX images; claimed 79% reduction in user clicks (4 vs 19) and possible reduction of inter-observer variability.
ai_features.quote: AI Auto Measure - 2D:  AI (Artificial Intelligence) based Cardiac Auto 2D feature that enables automated measurements on a PLAX images using similar process as IMT feature first released on Vivid 7, K051449 and manual workflow on predicate Vivid E95, K150087. This saves time compared to manual measurements, due to elimination of user interactions (clicks) by 79% (4 vs. 19). AI Auto Measure - 2D may also reduce inter-observer variability.

ai_features.name: AI Auto Measure - Spectrum Recognition
ai_features.function: AI-based recognition of common cardiac Doppler spectra that automatically starts the Auto Doppler measurement or opens the appropriate manual measurement folder.
ai_features.quote: AI Auto Measure - Spectrum Recognition: AI based Spectrum Recognition feature that enables automated recognition of common Doppler spectra and automatically starts the Auto Doppler measurement or opens the appropriate manual measurement folder.

ai_features.name: AFI 3.0

ai_features.name: Auto EF 3.0

ai_features.name: AFI RV

ai_features.quote: AFI RV: based on AFI 2.0 (cleared in K181685) but modified for the right ventricle (RV). It is a parametric tool giving quantitative data for right ventricular longitudinal global strain, free wall strain and segmental strain derived from the apical 4-chamber RV focused view.

ai_features.name: AFI LA
ai_features.function: Left-atrial global strain, LA volumes and emptying fraction (no AI/ML method stated).

ai_features.name: 4D Auto TVQ

notes: All five GE Vivid clearances are cardiac-focused platforms ("specialized for use in cardiac imaging") and each summary explicitly names a cardiac AI feature, so all are is_cardiac_ultrasound_ai=true. Lineage: K181685 (Oct 2018) is the first in this group to name an AI method - "Automatic View Recognition" is described as "based on deep neural network" and feeds AFI 2.0 / Auto EF 2.0 (explicitly for the Vivid E95/E90); AutoEF 2.0 and AFI 2.0 themselves are described only as workflow improvements of predicate K173341 functionality with no AI/ML claim. K200497 (Vivid S60N/S70N, Jul 2020) is the first clearance of the explicitly labeled "AI (Artificial Intelligence) based" features AI Auto Measure - 2D (PLAX) and AI Auto Measure - Spectrum Recognition (Doppler), plus AFI 3.0 / Auto EF 3.0 / AFI RV / AFI LA. K200743 (Vivid E80/E90/E95, Jul 2020) adds the same feature set to the E-series (its predicate is K181685; the AI Auto Measure - 2D entry there says 'automated' rather than 'semi-automated' and is the only place any quantitative claim appears: 79% fewer clicks, 4 vs 19). K200708 (Vivid iq) and K200851 (Vivid T8/T9), both Sep 2020, port every feature as "same feature as cleared on Vivid S70N (K200497)", so introduced_in_this_k=false for all their features. Only the AI Auto Measure features and Automatic View Recognition are explicitly described as AI/deep-learning in the FDA text; AFI, Auto EF, 4D Auto LAQ/TVQ and Scan Coach are listed as automated/guidance cardiac features without a stated ML method and are flagged accordingly in their function fields. None of the five summaries reports accuracy, agreement, or dataset/training-size figures; all state clinical studies were not required. Extraction caveat: K200497 pages 4-8 were extracted with a font-encoding shift (each ASCII character offset by 29); I decoded them programmatically, which recovers letters but drops digits and spaces, so the K200497 quotes are reconstructed readings marked '[decoded from font-shifted text]' and should be verified against the PDF; the content matches K200743 nearly word-for-word except 'semi-automated' vs 'automated'. K181685 pages 4-24 are similarly font-shifted Indications-for-Use grid forms (transducer tables) with no feature content; pages 25-29 (the 510(k) Summary) extracted cleanly. No web search was used; all determinations are grounded in the FDA text.
